ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited, through its wholly-owned subsidiary, has executed a significant 25-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (SECI) for a 300 MW assured Peak Power solar project. This long-term domestic contract, at a tariff of Rs. 6.00 per unit, provides a substantial and stable revenue stream starting in April 2028, materially expanding the company's renewable energy capacity and enhancing its future earnings visibility with no immediate red flags identified.
